data.value: {0} [TenantMismatch] The Entra token tenant differs from the Azure resource directory. Set Tenant ID to the resource subscription's directory ID in Settings, save, and sign in again. This may differ from the Work IQ/M365 tenant; the account also needs a Speech User role in the resource directory.

data.name: ErrorAzureAuth
data.value: {0} Entra authentication failed. Sign in again and confirm the token is for Azure Cognitive Services. Resource keys will not be used as a fallback.

data.name: ErrorAzureForbidden
data.value: {0} Access denied. Confirm the signed-in user has the Cognitive Services Speech User or Cognitive Services Speech Contributor role on this resource, and check tenant and network rules.

data.name: ErrorAzureBadRequest
data.value: {0} The service rejected the request. HTTP 400 alone does not prove an incorrect endpoint. Check the resource Tenant ID, Entra authorization and recognition parameters.

data.name: ErrorAzureThrottled
data.value: {0} The service is throttling requests. Check Speech quotas and reconnect later.

data.name: ErrorAzureConnection
data.value: {0} Connection unavailable. Check the endpoint, DNS, proxy, firewall and WebSocket network access.

data.name: ErrorAzureService
data.value: {0} The service returned an error. Confirm the Azure AI Services resource supports Speech, then check resource status and network configuration.

data.name: ErrorAzureStopped
data.value: {0} The session stopped. Check the endpoint, Entra authorization and resource configuration before reconnecting.

data.name: ErrorAzureSdkInit
data.value: Azure AI Speech [{0}] SDK initialization or connection failed. Check the endpoint, Entra authorization and local runtime.
